## Compasses

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="naturescompass:naturescompass" /><ItemIcon id="explorerscompass:explorerscompass" /></ItemGrid>

| Shown items |
| --- |
| <ItemLink id="naturescompass:naturescompass" /> |
| <ItemLink id="explorerscompass:explorerscompass" /> |

| Tool | Finds |
| --- | --- |
| Nature's Compass | Biomes, including supported modded biomes |
| Explorer's Compass | Structures, including supported modded structures |

A compass searches the current dimension. A failed search does not prove a feature is absent from the whole world.

***

## Getting started

### Biome finder

<Recipe id="naturescompass:natures_compass" />

Craft <ItemLink id="naturescompass:naturescompass" /> for biome searches.

### Structure finder

<Recipe id="explorerscompass:explorers_compass" />

Craft <ItemLink id="explorerscompass:explorerscompass" /> for structure searches.

Find the compass in Item recipe, craft it, then use it to choose a destination. Follow its bearing and distance. Save a waypoint once you arrive.

- [Browse recipe](help.search.md)

Search limits and server restrictions can affect results. Use Dimensions to choose the destination dimension first.

- [Dimensions](world.dimensions.md)

## 指南针

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="naturescompass:naturescompass" /><ItemIcon id="explorerscompass:explorerscompass" /></ItemGrid>

| 图示物品 |
| --- |
| <ItemLink id="naturescompass:naturescompass" /> |

| 工具 | 查找内容 |
| --- | --- |
| Nature's Compass | 生物群系，包括支持的模组生物群系 |
| Explorer's Compass | 结构，包括支持的模组结构 |

指南针搜索当前维度。一次搜索失败不代表整个世界没有该内容。

***

## 入门

### 生物群系查找

<Recipe id="naturescompass:natures_compass" />

制作 <ItemLink id="naturescompass:naturescompass" />，用于查找生物群系。

### 结构查找

<Recipe id="explorerscompass:explorers_compass" />

制作 <ItemLink id="explorerscompass:explorerscompass" />，用于查找结构。

在物品配方中查找并制作指南针，使用它选择目标。根据方向与距离前进，到达后保存路标。

- [浏览配方](help.search.md)

搜索范围与服务器限制会影响结果。先查看维度，确定目标所在维度。

- [维度](world.dimensions.md)

### Machine tool

<Recipe id="create:crafting/kinetics/wrench" />

Keep <ItemLink id="create:wrench" /> ready when adjusting Create components.
